User Story: As a job seeker, I want to filter vacancies by experience + technology
Summary: Selecting only the Experience filter shows vacancies matching that range regardless of technology
Selecting only the Technology filter shows vacancies matching that technology regardless of experience
Selecting Experience and Technology together shows only vacancies matching both criteria
Vacancy list updates immediately after selecting a filter without full page reload
Vacancy list updates immediately after removing a filter without full page reload
Vacancy list updates automatically when switching Technology option without full page reload
"No vacancies found for the selected filters" message shown when combined filter matches zero vacancies
"No vacancies found" message disappears once filter is adjusted to match at least one vacancy
"No vacancies found" message not shown when no filter applied and vacancies exist

User Story: As a job seeker, I want selected filters shown as removable tags
Summary: A tag is displayed for the selected Experience filter
A tag is displayed for the selected Technology filter
Two separate tags displayed when both filters selected
Clicking x on the Experience tag removes only that filter and keeps Technology active
Clicking x on the Technology tag removes only that filter and keeps Experience active
Vacancy list updates automatically after a tag is removed
"Clear all filters" link displayed when at least one filter is active
"Clear all filters" link not displayed when no filter is active
Clicking Clear all filters removes all tags and shows the full unfiltered list

User Story: As a job seeker, I want to save my filter combination as default search
Summary: "Save this search" button displayed to logged-in user after applying a filter
"Save this search" option not displayed to a guest user
"Save this search" button not available when no filter applied
Saved Experience/Technology filters auto-applied when user revisits Vacancies page
Vacancy list on page load matches saved filter combination results
Saved filters from one account are not applied to a different user's session
User can update saved search filter values from profile settings
User can remove saved search from profile settings
Vacancies page loads with no filters applied after saved search removed

User Story: As a recruiter, I want to compare my vacancy's performance with previous ones
Summary: "Compare with previous vacancies" section displayed on vacancy statistics page
Comparison uses only vacancies within the same job category
Comparison calculates average using exactly the last 5 previous vacancies in category
"Not enough data to compare" message shown when recruiter has 0 previous vacancies in category
"Not enough data to compare" message shown when recruiter has exactly 1 previous vacancy
Comparison data (not the message) shown when recruiter has exactly 2 previous vacancies
Vacancy owner (recruiter) can see the Compare section
A different recruiter (not owner) cannot see the Compare section
A guest (not logged-in) user cannot see the Compare section
